name: framer-multi-carousel
blurb: Responsive carousel showing multiple slides with breakpoint-based responsive columns.
description: Multi-slide carousel with responsive breakpoints. Shows 1 slide on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop. Supports custom breakpoint configuration. Navigate with prev/next buttons, snap animation via spring physics.
use_when: Product grids or image galleries where multiple items should be visible simultaneously.
avoid_when: When only showing one item at a time is desired.
a11y: Previous/next buttons provide navigation; keyboard support depends on button implementation.
